description: Perturbations et incidents affectant le réseau de Transport is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Ce jeu de données recense l’ensemble des perturbations et incidents en cours impactant les lignes de transport du réseau Métropole Aix-Marseille-Provence (MAMP). Il s’agit exclusivement des perturbations actives, transmises en temps réel par notre prestataire (travaux, déviations, arrêts non desservis, reports de terminus, etc.). Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are mobilite, transport. The portal shows 196 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-10-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
